basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 27-year-old software developer based in Atlanta, GA. I have a passion for gaming, especially sandbox and strategy games like Minecraft and chess. When I'm not coding or gaming, I love exploring the realms of psychedelics and their impact on consciousness, which is why you'll often find me browsing the DMTlab subreddit. I'm usually online during the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with people who share similar interests. Always up for a gaming session or a deep conversation!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for about 5 years. My love for gaming started in childhood, and I have self-taught myself various gaming strategies and tricks over the years. Additionally, I have a keen interest in psychology and psychedelics, which I explore through various online resources and communities.
